resources.name: CDC ICD-10-CM FY 2026 files
resources.notes: US ICD-10-CM reference only. Do not use as the primary Vietnamese ICD-10 source for Phase 1.

resources.name: CodiEsp corpus
resources.notes: Spanish clinical cases with ICD10/CIE10 coding and text references.

resources.name: ConText assertion algorithm
resources.notes: Source pattern for negation, hypothetical, historical, and experiencer cues.

resources.name: 2010 i2b2/VA concepts, assertions, and relations challenge
resources.notes: Do not commit data; adapter should read locally provided files after DUA approval.

resources.name: ICD-10 tiếng Việt theo TT 06/2026/TT-BYT
resources.notes: Primary ICD source for Viettel Phase 1; use reviewed structured extracts of 06-byt-kem.pdf.

resources.name: Vietnamese ICD-10 lookup
resources.notes: Use manually reviewed Vietnamese labels and aliases; align new bulk extracts to TT 06/2026/TT-BYT.

resources.name: MedlinePlus Health Topic XML
resources.notes: Use topic titles and also-called terms with attribution to MedlinePlus.gov.

resources.name: MIMIC-IV-Note
resources.notes: Do not download or commit; requires credentialed PhysioNet access and training.

resources.name: NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes
resources.notes: Do not vendor data; adapter should read user-provided local Kaggle files.

resources.name: NegEx
resources.notes: Source pattern for rule-based negation cue and scope heuristics.

resources.name: Reviewed Phase 1 standard concept allowlist
resources.notes: Exact-match standard concept exceptions for conservative runtime merge guards; every row requires manual review.

resources.name: RxNav REST API lookups on 2026-07-04
resources.notes: Manual curation batch for Phase 1 drug mentions found in local input files.

resources.name: RxNorm current release and RxNav API
resources.notes: Generic current-release pointer; Phase 1 remains locked to June 1 2026 while the imported July 6 candidate is evaluated.
resources.version: current pointer resolved by locked source_versions.json

resources.name: RxNorm Full Monthly Release June 1 2026
resources.notes: Fallback coverage when prescribable content misses a legitimate medication mention.

resources.name: RxNorm Full Monthly Release July 6 2026
resources.notes: Imported from the root rrf subtree; includes active BN fallback terms absent from Prescribable Content.

resources.name: RxNorm Current Prescribable Content Monthly Release June 1 2026
resources.notes: Primary RxNorm source for Phase 1 drug candidates; parse RXNCONSO/RXNREL/RXNSAT.

resources.name: RxNorm Current Prescribable Content Monthly Release July 6 2026
resources.notes: Imported from the prescribe/rrf subtree of the July full bundle; pending ablation before promotion.

resources.name: Local seed curation
resources.notes: Hand-curated bootstrap rows maintained in this repository.

resources.name: Synthea synthetic patient generator
resources.notes: Synthetic, non-PHI patient records; suitable for pipeline smoke and scale testing.

resources.name: Reviewed Vietnamese clinical LOCAL lexicon
resources.notes: Source-backed local curation for Vietnamese symptoms, lab names, and future procedure terms.

resources.name: WHO ICD-10 2019 ClaML and browser
resources.notes: Reference source for ICD hierarchy and stable disease grouping, not the primary Vietnamese label source.

icd10_vn.notes: Phase 1 ICD candidates should use Vietnamese ICD-10 labels from TT 06/2026/TT-BYT or reviewed KCB extracts. CDC ICD-10-CM is not a primary source.

phase1_reviewed_standard_allowlist.notes: Manually reviewed exact-match standard concept exceptions for controlled runtime merge guards.

candidate_release.notes: July is imported and audited as a promotion candidate; the reproducible Phase 1 baseline remains locked to June until an ablation approves the switch.

rxnorm.notes: Use prescribable RxNorm as the primary drug dictionary and full monthly release as fallback coverage.

vn_clinical_lexicon.notes: Reviewed LOCAL symptom and lab aliases can be merged into Phase 1 runtime; procedure rows are kept for later phases until export support exists.
